chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhl from Yunus ibn Ya'qub said:
I saw Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) straightening the pebbles in the place of his prostration between the two prostrations.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq do with the pebbles between the two prostrations during prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) meticulously arranging the pebbles (*hisa*) between the two prostrations, illustrating the meticulous attention to physical detail (*adab*) in Shia ritual practice. This act underscores the principle that even minor adjustments in the posture of worship contribute to the completeness and reverence of the prayer, reflecting the Imams' role in preserving the precise methodology of the Prophet. It serves as a practical guide for worshippers to ensure their prostration surfaces are orderly, enhancing the spiritual focus during the transition between prostrations.
